name: linear
description: Reads Linear GraphQL list/connection data and exposes typed fixed GraphQL reverse-ETL mutations where connector-local schemas can do so without raw GraphQL passthrough.

risk.read: fixed Linear GraphQL documents against documented root Query list/connection fields
risk.write: fixed Linear GraphQL mutations; destructive/delete/archive operations require typed destructive confirmation when implemented
risk.approval: reverse ETL writes require plan, preview, explicit approval, and execute; destructive actions require typed confirmation
